meta.heading: Round 18: a wiki, MOPs on tickets, and fewer ways round
meta.intro: A look over Shiftbook as it is now. The card that popped up by itself is gone (first card). Then a wiki for what you know, MOPs that live on their change ticket, and trimming the tabs, names and doubled-up features. Pick on each card; each choice stands alone.

r18-check.title: What I checked: the card that popped up, and two Find fixes
body: **The card that appeared by itself is gone.** It had two causes, both fixed and both still in the app after everything that merged since: adding time to older work made a **third box** (now the same work is one card, with its days inside), and adding a ticket could leave an **empty card** (fixed, with a test so it can't come back). All the app's tests pass on the latest main.

**Cards still appear on their own in three ways, on purpose:** pasting on the Desk (a ticket number makes a ticket card, other text makes a jot); adding time or *Log again today* on an older day makes today's entry, which joins the same card unless its name or project differs; and the side panels (Where was I?, Due soon, Wrap-up), which are panels, not cards.

**Fixed in this PR, from the audit below:** Find's *Go to* list showed the wrong number keys (it said 5 for Settings; it's 8) and had no Repeating, Lists or Items. It now lists every tab with its real key. Find's *Tidy the Desk* made piles while the Desk's *Tidy up…* puts cards away; it's now called **Tidy into stacks**, like the Desk's button. On a phone, Find no longer offers Desk and board commands that did nothing there.

r18-wiki.title: A wiki for what you know, instead of MOPs in a notebook
body: **What it is:** pages you write once and find again, in **spaces** (Network, Servers, your own). Pages can sit under pages. Type `[[` to link another page; each page lists what links to it (**Linked from**) and the tickets that mention it (**On tickets**). Find (Ctrl Space) searches pages first.

**Templates live here too**, in a Templates space: a **MOP** template (runs as a checklist with a status, next card) or a **List** template (a plain checklist, like a new starter's setup). Blanks become `{{site}}` instead of `[[site]]`, because `[[` now makes a link; your templates are changed over for you.

**Other teams, honestly:** a space is the thing that gets shared, so it's built to be shared later. But Shiftbook on your computer never goes online, so sharing a space with a team needs the hosted version (Phase 2). Until then, **Export a space** writes it as Markdown files anyone can open, with the usual warning that they aren't locked. If team access soon is the main goal, a wiki your company already runs gets there faster, and this one becomes where you write it up first and keep your own.
Your Pages (the note kind) move into the wiki as they are. Nothing else about notes changes on this card.

r18-mop.title: MOPs on their ticket: made from a template, run as a checklist
body: **A MOP belongs to its change ticket.** Open a ticket (its card, the tickets box on an entry, or the Tickets tab) and it has two tabs: **Notepad** (as now) and **MOP**. Pick a template, answer its blanks once (the ticket number and title fill themselves) and the MOP is attached.

**It has a status:** Draft, Ready, Running, Done or Backed out, shown on the ticket's card. Three modes: **Read**, **Edit** and **Run**. Run is the checklist from the MOP notebook: ticking a heading crosses out everything under it, and each tick keeps its time, so **Copy run log** gives you the steps with times for the change record.
**The change window** (from the `{{window}}` blank, or set by hand) shows on the bottom bar and in the bell before it starts, like pins with a chase day.
**Finding old MOPs:** search the ticket number, or open the template: it lists every ticket it was used on and how each one ended.

**The MOP notebook window** (tabs, Numbered, Minimal, Checklist) would retire: its Run checklist and line numbers move into the MOP tab, and the MOP tab can pop out or fill the screen. Dropping MOP files in still works; each file becomes a wiki page or template.

r18-tabs.title: Fewer tabs: 8 down to 6 and a gear
body: I went through every button, menu, key and Find command. The biggest source of *where do I go for this?* is the tabs: eight of them, and some overlap. **Lists** has only its tab and key as ways in; **Items** is really your tickets; **Settings** is something you visit, not a place you work.
Pick the changes you want. Each one stands on its own.

r18-names.title: One name for each thing
body: The same thing goes by different names in different places, and two different things share a name (*Tidy the Desk* meant both piling cards up and clearing them away; *Jot* is both a note and, in the bell, an Inbox scrap). Tick the ones to change; the right-hand column is the name everywhere.

r18-dupes.title: Doubled-up features to cut back
body: Things that grew up separately and now do nearly the same job:

**Done tickets** live in four places (the tray, the Desk's Done today pile, a Done tickets board, and Items › Done). **Meeting notes** can be made three ways, and only one of them files the note under its meeting series. **Today's daily note** has three editors. **After unlocking**, *Where was I?* and *While you were away* both open at once. Some menus list **Follow up tomorrow** and then a Follow up section with Tomorrow in it.
Pick what to cut. Nothing you've written is lost: these are ways in, not data.

body: There are two sheets. Rounds 15 to 17 went on a newer one that this session can't open (it belongs to another account), so round 18 is here, on the one we used for rounds 8 to 14. The round file is also in the repo (`tools/signoff/rounds/r18.json`), so it can be loaded onto the other sheet.
**Archived here:** the round 13 and 14 *Built* cards. Those steps shipped long ago.

**Out of date on the round 17 sheet:** *Add a ticket card to an entry*, *Logged jots and scraps keep their spot* and *Ticking a ticket on an entry closes it in the Tickets panel* still say **not merged yet**, but all three are merged. The MOP notebook lines in *The last batch* and *Notes, windows and the bell* change if the MOP and wiki cards here are approved.
